instructions.question: How much step-by-step reasoning does the work that `user_message` asks for need, given `recent_context`?
instructions.rate: Rate the work the request asks for, not how important its topic sounds. Advice or an explanation given in words, even about architecture or security, is not design work.
instructions.short_replies: When `user_message` only approves, continues or picks an option (such as "go ahead", "1", "继续"), rate the work it approves, as described at the end of `recent_context`.

criteria: Answered from what is already known, or mechanical work with nothing to work out: a lookup, a single command, a rename or find-and-replace (even across many files), a search that lists what it finds, formatting, a one-line change.
An ordinary, well-specified change to one or a few files, or a direct question about code already in view.
A change across several files that needs working out, a bug whose cause is described but has to be traced, writing tests, or reviewing a diff with care.
Design across several components, a bug whose cause is unknown, a refactor with many dependents, or careful reasoning about concurrency, performance or failure modes.
Novel architecture, a security or data-integrity question, a failure that resisted earlier attempts, or work where a subtle mistake is costly and hard to undo.

instructions.question: Which of these skills, if any, is the right one to load for the work that `user_message` asks for, given `recent_context`?
instructions.focus: Match the kind of work asked for (such as debugging a failure, planning, reviewing, designing, writing a document), not only a product or technology the message names.
instructions.platforms: A skill for one product or platform fits only when `user_message` or `recent_context` shows that product is the one in use here; otherwise choose a general skill or none.
instructions.short_replies: When `user_message` only approves, continues or picks an option (such as "go ahead", "1", "继续"), judge the work it approves, as described at the end of `recent_context`.

agents.what: Build voice AI agents with natural conversations, tools, and workflows using ElevenLabs.
agents.use_when: Creating voice assistants, chatbots, customer service agents, configuring agent tools, procedures, or publishing agents.
agents.not_for: Text-only chatbots without voice, non-conversational AI, or services not using ElevenLabs.
agents.用途: 使用ElevenLabs构建具有自然对话、工具和工作流的语音AI代理。
agents.何时用: 创建语音助手、聊天机器人、客户服务代理、配置代理工具和程序或发布代理时。
agents.何时不用: 不需要语音的纯文本聊天机器人、非对话型AI或不使用ElevenLabs的服务。

code-review.what: Review code changes against repo standards and spec requirements in parallel.
code-review.use_when: User wants to review a branch, PR, or changes since a commit, tag, or merge-base.
code-review.not_for: Linting or automated tooling; single-axis style checks; reviews without a fixed point.
code-review.用途: 按代码规范和需求规格并行审查代码变更。
code-review.何时用: 用户要求审查分支、拉取请求或某个提交/标签以来的变更。
code-review.何时不用: 代码检查工具；单轴风格检查；无固定对比点的审查。

codebase-design.what: Provides vocabulary and principles for designing deep modules with small interfaces and hidden complexity.
codebase-design.use_when: User wants to design module interfaces, improve testability, find deepening opportunities, or decide where seams go.
codebase-design.not_for: Implementation details, specific language features, or architectural patterns beyond module-level design.
codebase-design.用途: 提供深模块设计的术语和原则，用小接口隐藏复杂实现逻辑。
codebase-design.何时用: 用户需要设计模块接口、改进可测试性、找到深化机会或确定接缝位置。
codebase-design.何时不用: 实现细节、特定语言特性或超出模块级设计范围的架构模式。

diagnosing-bugs.what: Systematic diagnosis of hard bugs and performance regressions through tight feedback loops.
diagnosing-bugs.use_when: User reports something broken, failing, throwing errors, or running slow; asks to debug or diagnose.
diagnosing-bugs.not_for: Feature requests, code reviews, refactoring, or general how-to questions.
diagnosing-bugs.用途: 通过紧密反馈循环系统诊断疑难 bug 和性能回退。
diagnosing-bugs.何时用: 用户报告代码崩溃、异常、失败或性能变慢；要求调试或诊断问题。
diagnosing-bugs.何时不用: 功能需求、代码审查、重构或通用技术问题。

domain-modeling.what: Build and refine a project's domain model through active terminology work.
domain-modeling.use_when: Discussing codebase terminology, creating or editing GLOSSARY.md, or writing ADRs.
domain-modeling.not_for: Passively reading existing glossaries or implementing code features.
domain-modeling.用途: 通过主动术语工作来构建和完善项目的领域模型。
domain-modeling.何时用: 讨论代码库术语、创建或编辑GLOSSARY.md、或编写ADR时使用。
domain-modeling.何时不用: 被动阅读现有词汇表或实现代码功能。

dubbing.what: Dub audio and video into other languages while preserving original speaker voices.
dubbing.use_when: Translating videos, podcasts, or recordings into other languages; localizing media content; editing dubbing transcripts.
dubbing.not_for: Transcription, subtitle generation, voice cloning, or general audio editing.
dubbing.用途: 使用ElevenLabs API将音频和视频配音成其他语言，保留原始说话者的声音。
dubbing.何时用: 将视频、播客或录音翻译成其他语言；本地化媒体内容；编辑配音转录和翻译。
dubbing.何时不用: 语音识别、字幕生成、声音克隆或常规音频编辑。

ego-browser.what: Automates browser tasks like navigating websites, filling forms, clicking buttons, and extracting data.
ego-browser.use_when: You need to open websites, interact with web apps, test web interfaces, or automate browser workflows.
ego-browser.not_for: Non-browser tasks like file processing, calculations, or API calls without a web interface.
ego-browser.用途: 自动化浏览器任务，如导航网站、填写表单、点击按钮和提取数据。
ego-browser.何时用: 需要打开网站、与网络应用交互、测试网页界面或自动化浏览器工作流。
ego-browser.何时不用: 非浏览器任务，如文件处理、计算或无网页界面的API调用。

git-guardrails-claude-code.what: Set up Claude Code hooks to block dangerous git commands like push and reset.
git-guardrails-claude-code.use_when: User wants to prevent destructive git operations or add git safety guardrails to Claude Code.
git-guardrails-claude-code.not_for: General git workflow help, branch management, or reviewing git history.
git-guardrails-claude-code.用途: 设置Claude Code钩子以阻止危险的git命令（如push和reset）。
git-guardrails-claude-code.何时用: 用户想防止破坏性git操作或为Claude Code添加git安全保护。
git-guardrails-claude-code.何时不用: 一般git工作流帮助、分支管理或git历史查看。

grilling.what: Systematically challenges plans, decisions, or ideas through relentless questioning.
grilling.use_when: User wants to stress-test thinking, validate decisions, or uses grill-related trigger phrases.
grilling.not_for: Providing advice, solutions, or information; casual brainstorming without critical scrutiny.
grilling.用途: 通过持续质疑来系统地挑战计划、决定或想法。
grilling.何时用: 用户希望检验思路、验证决策或使用相关触发词语时。
grilling.何时不用: 提供建议、解决方案或信息；无批判性的头脑风暴。

herdr.what: Control Herdr terminal multiplexer to manage panes, tabs, workspaces, and coding agents.
herdr.use_when: User explicitly mentions Herdr or asks to inspect or control terminal layout and agents.
herdr.not_for: General background tasks, delegation, or parallel work without explicit Herdr mention.
herdr.用途: 控制Herdr终端多路复用器来管理窗格、标签、工作区和编码代理。
herdr.何时用: 用户明确提及Herdr或要求检查或控制终端布局和代理。
herdr.何时不用: 没有明确提及Herdr的后台任务、委派或并行工作。

img2-img2glb.what: Converts a single image into a GLB 3D mesh using TRELLIS reconstruction.
img2-img2glb.use_when: User wants to turn an image into a 3D GLB mesh file or 3D model.
img2-img2glb.not_for: Batch image processing, multi-view 3D generation, OBJ export, or non-image inputs.
img2-img2glb.用途: 使用TRELLIS重建服务将单张图像转换为GLB 3D网格。
img2-img2glb.何时用: 用户需要将图像转换为3D GLB网格文件或3D模型。
img2-img2glb.何时不用: 批量图像处理、多视图3D生成、OBJ导出或非图像输入。

img2threejs.what: Convert reference images into animation-ready procedural Three.js 3D models through staged sculpting.
img2threejs.use_when: You have an object or character image and need a code-built 3D model, reconstruction spec, or sculpt plan.
img2threejs.not_for: Photogrammetry, mesh extraction, downloading pre-made models, or converting existing 3D files.
img2threejs.用途: 通过分阶段雕刻流程将参考图像转换为动画就绪的Three.js程序化3D模型。
img2threejs.何时用: 您有对象或角色图像，需要代码构建的3D模型、重建规范或雕刻计划。
img2threejs.何时不用: 摄影测量、网格提取、下载预制模型或转换现有3D文件。

jev-batch.what: Batch-sorts tens to thousands of text items into fixed categories with confidence scores.
jev-batch.use_when: You have text already in hand and need to classify, route, or rank it by closed options.
jev-batch.not_for: Single items, open-ended answers, or tasks requiring code execution or tool calls.
jev-batch.用途: 把几十到几千条文字分拣到固定答案里，输出带概率的结果。
jev-batch.何时用: 已有文字在手，需要分类、路由或按概率排序。
jev-batch.何时不用: 单条项目、开放性问题、需要执行代码或调用工具的任务。

jev-browser-agent.what: Runs browser experiments with fast TypeSafe Jev decisions replacing full LLM reasoning.
jev-browser-agent.use_when: Automating browser tasks needing rapid, cost-efficient element selection and operation choices.
jev-browser-agent.not_for: Login flows, CAPTCHAs, or tasks requiring full LLM reasoning over page snapshots.
jev-browser-agent.用途: 使用TypeSafe Jev快速决策运行浏览器实验，替代完整LLM推理。
jev-browser-agent.何时用: 自动化浏览器任务，需要快速、低成本的元素选择和操作决策。
jev-browser-agent.何时不用: 登录流程、验证码或需要完整LLM页面推理的任务。

migrate-to-shoehorn.what: Migrate test files from `as` type assertions to @total-typescript/shoehorn.
migrate-to-shoehorn.use_when: User mentions shoehorn, wants to replace `as` in tests, or needs partial test data.
migrate-to-shoehorn.not_for: Production code, runtime assertions, or non-test files.
migrate-to-shoehorn.用途: 将测试文件中的 `as` 类型断言迁移到 @total-typescript/shoehorn。
migrate-to-shoehorn.何时用: 用户提到 shoehorn、想替换测试中的 `as` 或需要部分测试数据。
migrate-to-shoehorn.何时不用: 生产代码、运行时断言或非测试文件。

mobilebuildmcp-cli.what: Build, test, run, and debug iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps.
mobilebuildmcp-cli.use_when: Building, testing, running, debugging, or automating Apple platform mobile and desktop applications.
mobilebuildmcp-cli.not_for: Android development, web apps, or general purpose command-line tasks.
mobilebuildmcp-cli.用途: 构建、测试、运行和调试 iOS、macOS、watchOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用。

mobilebuildmcp-cli.何时不用: Android 开发、Web 应用或其他通用命令行任务。

music.what: Generate music from text prompts using ElevenLabs API.
music.use_when: Creating instrumental tracks, songs with lyrics, background music, jingles, or any AI-generated music composition.
music.not_for: Editing existing audio, voice synthesis, or music analysis.

openai-image.what: Generate or edit reference images using OpenAI's GPT Image models via Node SDK.
openai-image.use_when: User needs to create, modify, or iteratively refine reference images with AI.
openai-image.not_for: Image processing, upscaling, background removal, or non-reference image tasks.
openai-image.用途: 用OpenAI的GPT Image模型生成或编辑参考图。
openai-image.何时用: 用户需要生成、改图或多轮迭代编辑参考图时。
openai-image.何时不用: 图像处理、超分、抠图等非参考图的任务。

pr.what: Formats pull request bodies using a structured template with summary, evidence, and merge danger sections.
pr.use_when: Writing or reviewing PR descriptions that need clear formatting, risk assessment, and before-after evidence.
pr.not_for: Creating commit messages, release notes, or general documentation outside of PR contexts.
pr.用途: 使用结构化模板格式化拉取请求正文，包含总结、证据和合并风险部分。
pr.何时用: 编写或审查需要清晰格式化、风险评估和对比证据的拉取请求描述时。
pr.何时不用: 创建提交消息、发布说明或拉取请求上下文之外的常规文档。

prototype.what: Build throwaway prototypes to validate design questions about logic, state models, or UI.
prototype.use_when: You need to sanity-check whether a state model feels right or explore what a UI should look like.
prototype.not_for: Production code, polished implementations, or questions not about design validation.
prototype.用途: 构建一次性原型来验证关于逻辑、状态模型或UI的设计问题。
prototype.何时用: 需要检验状态模型是否合理，或探索UI的外观设计时使用。
prototype.何时不用: 生产代码、完整实现或非设计验证的问题。

research.what: Investigates questions against primary sources and writes findings to a Markdown file.
research.use_when: User wants research done, documentation gathered, or API facts verified from official sources.
research.not_for: Quick answers, summaries of existing write-ups, or tasks not requiring primary source verification.
research.用途: 针对主要信息源进行调查研究，并将结果写入Markdown文件。
research.何时用: 用户需要研究某个话题、收集文档资料或验证官方API事实。
research.何时不用: 快速解答、现有文章摘要或不需要查证主要信息源的任务。

scaffold-exercises.what: Creates exercise directory structures with problems, solutions, and explainers passing linting.
scaffold-exercises.use_when: User wants to scaffold exercises, create exercise stubs, or set up a new course section.
scaffold-exercises.not_for: Editing existing exercises, writing exercise content, or managing non-exercise directories.
scaffold-exercises.用途: 创建通过代码检查的练习目录结构，包含问题、解决方案和讲解器。
scaffold-exercises.何时用: 用户想要搭建练习框架、创建练习存根或设置新课程部分。
scaffold-exercises.何时不用: 编辑现有练习、编写练习内容或管理非练习目录。

setup-api-key.use_when: User needs to set up ElevenLabs API key or an API request fails due to missing key.
setup-api-key.not_for: Using ElevenLabs services after the key is already configured and working.

setup-pre-commit.use_when: User wants to add pre-commit hooks, configure Husky, set up lint-staged, or add commit-time formatting and validation.
setup-pre-commit.not_for: Configuring linters like ESLint, setting up CI/CD pipelines, or modifying existing hook behavior.

sound-effects.what: Generate sound effects from text descriptions using ElevenLabs API.
sound-effects.use_when: Creating sound effects, ambient sounds, UI sounds, cinematic impacts, or audio textures from text prompts.
sound-effects.not_for: Speech synthesis, voice generation, music composition, or audio without text descriptions.
sound-effects.用途: 使用 ElevenLabs API 从文本描述生成音效。
sound-effects.何时用: 创建音效、环境音、UI 音效、电影撞击音或其他音频纹理。
sound-effects.何时不用: 语音合成、语音生成、音乐创作或没有文本描述的音频。

speech-engine.use_when: Building voice-enabled chat servers, WebSocket handlers, browser clients, or voice agents with custom server logic.
speech-engine.not_for: Creating hosted ElevenLabs Conversational AI agents with platform-managed prompts and tools.
speech-engine.用途: 使用 ElevenLabs Speech Engine 为自定义代理添加实时语音对话功能。
speech-engine.何时用: 构建启用语音的聊天服务器、WebSocket 处理器、浏览器客户端或具有自定义服务器逻辑的语音代理。

speech-to-text.what: Transcribes audio and video files to text using ElevenLabs Scribe v2.
speech-to-text.use_when: Converting audio/video to text, generating subtitles, transcribing meetings, identifying speakers.
speech-to-text.not_for: Text-to-speech, real-time voice processing, audio editing or manipulation.
speech-to-text.用途: 使用ElevenLabs Scribe v2将音频和视频文件转录为文本。
speech-to-text.何时用: 转换音频或视频为文本、生成字幕、转录会议、识别说话者。
speech-to-text.何时不用: 文本转语音、实时语音处理、音频编辑或处理。

tdd.what: Guide test-driven development using red-green-refactor cycles with public interface testing.
tdd.use_when: Building features or fixing bugs test-first, red-green-refactor workflows, or integration test design.
tdd.not_for: Code review, refactoring guidance, or testing strategies beyond TDD methodology.
tdd.用途: 使用红绿重构循环指导测试驱动开发，通过公共接口测试。
tdd.何时用: 先写测试构建功能、修复bug、红绿重构工作流或集成测试设计。
tdd.何时不用: 代码审查、重构指导或TDD方法论之外的测试策略。

text-to-speech.what: Converts text to natural speech audio using ElevenLabs AI in 70+ languages.
text-to-speech.use_when: Creating voiceovers, audio from text, voice apps, or synthesizing speech in multiple languages.
text-to-speech.not_for: Speech recognition, audio editing, music generation, or voice cloning without API setup.
text-to-speech.用途: 使用ElevenLabs AI将文本转换为70多种语言的自然语音音频。
text-to-speech.何时用: 创建配音、文本转音频、语音应用或多语言语音合成。
text-to-speech.何时不用: 语音识别、音频编辑、音乐生成或未配置API的声音克隆。

update-skills-from-changelog.not_for: Manually editing individual skill files or updating skills from GitHub issues.
update-skills-from-changelog.用途: 从合并的周报更新 ElevenLabs 代理技能文档。
update-skills-from-changelog.何时用: changelog 合并到 elevenlabs-dx main，或要求从特定日期更新技能。
update-skills-from-changelog.何时不用: 手动编辑技能文件或从 GitHub issue 更新技能。

voice-changer.use_when: Converting existing audio to a different speaker, dubbing, re-voicing, or applying speech-to-speech voice conversion.
voice-changer.not_for: Creating new voices from samples or cloning voices; use voice cloning for that instead.
voice-changer.用途: 将音频录音中的声音转换为不同的目标声音，同时保留情感和时序。
voice-changer.何时用: 将现有音频转换为不同的说话人、配音、重新配音或应用语音转换。

voice-isolator.use_when: Cleaning noisy recordings, removing music from dialogue, isolating speech, prepping for transcription.
voice-isolator.not_for: Audio generation, voice conversion, speech recognition, music production beyond isolation.
voice-isolator.用途: 使用ElevenLabs API从音频中移除背景噪音并隔离人声。
voice-isolator.何时用: 清理嘈杂录音、从对白中去除音乐、隔离语音、为转录做准备。
voice-isolator.何时不用: 音频生成、声音转换、语音识别、超出隔离范围的音乐制作。

wizard.not_for: Automating tasks the agent can perform itself or scripting fully automated procedures.

writing-for-agents.not_for: Writing agent logic, implementing skill code, or designing agent workflows.

simplify.what: Refactor code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and cleanup.

fewer-permission-prompts.what: Analyzes transcripts to create an allowlist of safe Bash and MCP tool calls in settings.

loop.what: Executes a prompt or command repeatedly at specified intervals or self-paced.

loop.用途: 按指定间隔或自主节奏重复执行提示词或命令。

schedule.what: Create, update, list, or execute scheduled cloud agents on cron schedules.

schedule.何时用: 需要设置循环自动化任务、管理现有计划或定期触发代理。

claude-api.what: Reference for Claude API, models, pricing, parameters, streaming, tool use, agents.

workflow-authoring.what: Reference guide for writing Workflow tool scripts using the script API.

run.what: Launch and run the project's app to test changes in a live environment.

security-review.what: Reviews pending changes on the current branch for security vulnerabilities and risks.

anthropic-skills:built-in-browser.what: Use the built-in browser pane in Claude desktop app to browse websites.

anthropic-skills:computer-use.what: Control your computer desktop: take screenshots, click, type, and scroll in native apps.

anthropic-skills:deep-research.what: Coordinates research across multiple sources and synthesizes findings into comprehensive reports.

anthropic-skills:google-workspace.what: Create, edit, and format Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides files in Drive.

grill-me.what: Conducts a rigorous interview to refine and stress-test your plan or design.

grill-with-docs.what: Conducts intensive interviews to refine plans or designs while generating documentation.

handoff.what: Summarize conversation into a handoff document for the next agent.

implement.what: Implement work based on specifications or tickets using test-driven development.

retro.what: Analyze a coding session and suggest improvements to the development environment.

to-questionnaire.what: Create a structured questionnaire to gather missing knowledge from someone else.

to-questionnaire.not_for: Surveys, feedback forms, or questions for people without specialized knowledge you need.

to-questionnaire.何时用: 需要从另一个人那里获取特定信息或决策以继续推进工作。
to-questionnaire.何时不用: 调查问卷、反馈表单或向没有你需要的专业知识的人提问。

to-spec.what: Synthesize current conversation into a spec and publish to issue tracker.

to-spec.not_for: Gathering new requirements, interviewing users, or exploring undefined ideas.
to-spec.用途: 将当前对话合成规格说明并发布到问题跟踪器。
to-spec.何时用: 已讨论功能需求，需要将其正式化为规格说明文档。
to-spec.何时不用: 收集新需求、采访用户或探索未定义的想法。
